summary: Cameron Faulkner's Polygon guide explains how to shop Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2023, noting that deals now start early (Nov. 17) and extend through December. It covers retailer memberships, free Amazon Prime games, price-matching and extended return policies at major retailers, and tools for tracking prices yourself.
one_line: A Polygon guide to 2023 Black Friday shopping covering memberships, price matching, holiday return policies, and deal-tracking tools like CamelCamelCamel and Honey.
key_facts: In 2023, Black Friday falls on Friday, Nov. 24, and Cyber Monday on Monday, Nov. 27.
The best 2023 Black Friday deals kicked off on Nov. 17 at Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, and other retailers.
Costco's membership costs $60 and can pay for itself quickly with holiday purchases, especially bulk food.
Walmart Plus costs $99 per year ($50 for a limited time); early access to deals requires a paid membership, not the free 30-day trial.
Best Buy's My Best Buy Plus and Total memberships cost $49.99 and $179.99, respectively.
Amazon Prime offers a free 30-day trial, and Prime members get free games and DLC all year, such as Rage 2, Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, and Doom 3.
Amazon does not price match, but its "Pre-order Price Guarantee" ensures pre-orders get the lowest price before launch.
Best Buy matches "qualified competitors"; most products bought through Dec. 30 can be price-matched through Jan. 13, 2024.
Walmart will not price match competitors or online purchases that later drop in price.
Target allows price adjustments on purchases made between Oct. 22 and Dec. 24 with proof of purchase.
Target accepts most unopened items in new condition within 90 days of purchase.
Walmart accepts returns of items bought Oct. 1 to Dec. 31 through Jan. 31, 2024.
Amazon items bought Nov. 1 to Dec. 31 can be returned before Jan. 31, 2024, but Apple-brand products only through Jan. 15, 2024.
CamelCamelCamel tracks Amazon price history and sends email alerts; it can import Amazon wishlists and offers the Camelizer browser extension.
Honey tracks price history across multiple retailers and automatically searches for promo codes at checkout.
